flags.name: project-id
flags.description: 项目 UUID；省略时使用当前项目
flags.constraints: UUID

flags.name: node-id
flags.description: 稳定 node_id；省略时生成
flags.constraints: canonical Node ID; generated when omitted

flags.name: update-id
flags.description: 稳定更新 UUID；省略时生成
flags.constraints: UUID

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: 只做本地校验并输出计划；不连接服务端、不写草稿、不报价或扣分
flags.constraints: local validation only; no runtime, network, draft write, credit estimate, approval, journal, dispatch, or credit side effects

flags.name: title
flags.description: 节点标题；按 flag 出现更新
flags.constraints: at most 512 UTF-16 code units

flags.name: tag
flags.description: 颜色标签 ID，可重复传入；取值 default-tag-1..default-tag-5，除非用户明确指定标签否则不要默认传
flags.constraints: default-tag-1|default-tag-2|default-tag-3|default-tag-4|default-tag-5; max 5; omit unless the user explicitly asks for color labels

flags.name: clear-tags
flags.description: 把节点标签完整集合清空

flags.name: mode
flags.description: 图片生成模式：t2i（text-to-image，文生图）或 i2i（image-to-image，图生图）；提供生成参数时必须显式指定，纯元信息更新或清空生成配置无需传入
flags.constraints: t2i|i2i (t2i=text-to-image, i2i=image-to-image); explicitly required when any generation parameter is supplied; metadata-only saves and clear-generation do not require mode

flags.name: prompt
flags.description: 完整图片生成提示词；引用写成 {{node:node_xxx}}、{{res:resourceId}}、{{uri:value}} 或 {{vid:value}}，写字面 {{ 用 \{{ 转义；画布已有来源节点时优先使用 Node ID，保留上游连线；Resource ID 用于资产库等无来源节点的素材或用户明确要求冻结，不自动从节点产物提取
flags.constraints: may be empty at save time if the model spec permits; Core validates effective text before run; create --run needs explicit title when prompt is empty

flags.name: model
flags.description: 服务端登记的图片模型标识

flags.name: ratio
flags.description: 图片宽高比，例如 1:1

flags.name: resolution
flags.description: 图片分辨率，例如 1K

flags.name: count
flags.description: 生成数量；上限以 model list 返回的 --count max 为准
flags.constraints: >0 and int32; dynamic maximum is the --count max from model list

flags.name: ref
flags.description: 完整类型化引用集合：node:value、res:value、uri:value 或 vid:value，可重复传入；画布已有来源节点时优先使用 Node ID，保留上游连线；Resource ID 用于资产库等无来源节点的素材或用户明确要求冻结，不自动从节点产物提取
flags.constraints: ordered type:value references; type is node|res|uri|vid; node value requires node_ prefix; res value requires canonical lowercase UUID

flags.name: resource-id
flags.description: 本节点已有产物的资源 UUID，可重复传入；需同时提供 --import-kind local_upload 或 external_generated。多个视为同一批次内的候选，顺序即候选顺序，首个为主选。资源须已登记、状态成功且类型为图片
flags.constraints: Resource IDs; create only; requires import-kind=local_upload|external_generated; first is primary

flags.name: import-kind
flags.description: 节点导入类别：local_upload（挂本地上传登记的资源）或 external_generated（外部平台生成产物导入）；与 resource upload 的登记意图同一套词汇
flags.constraints: local_upload | external_generated; may stand alone; required by resource-id; custom position requires external_generated

flags.name: x
flags.description: external_generated 导入节点在根画布中的 X 坐标；必须与 --y 成组提供
flags.constraints: requires import-kind=external_generated and y

flags.name: y
flags.description: external_generated 导入节点在根画布中的 Y 坐标；必须与 --x 成组提供
flags.constraints: requires import-kind=external_generated and x

flags.name: run
flags.description: 保存后依次报价、批准并运行该节点
flags.constraints: when false, only save the draft; when true, save → estimate → approve → run

flags.name: submit-id
flags.description: 稳定提交 UUID；--run 或 --resource-id 时省略则生成，停顿后续跑或重试导入须复用它
flags.constraints: UUID; with run, or with resource-id as the imported resource batch identity; generated when omitted; non-empty when supplied

flags.name: credit-token
flags.description: 已批准的 creditConfirmationToken；--run 时使用
flags.constraints: only with run; creditConfirmationToken issued by node confirm; mutually exclusive with credit-ceiling

flags.name: credit-ceiling
flags.description: 批准的积分消费上限；--run 时报价超过它会在运行前停止
flags.constraints: >=0; only with run; mutually exclusive with credit-token; stops before run when the estimate exceeds it

flags.name: wait
flags.description: --run 后等待该节点生成进入终态
flags.constraints: only with run; wait for the submitted node to become terminal

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: --wait 的最长等待时间；默认 10m，0 表示只查询一次
flags.constraints: only with wait; 0 means query once

flags.name: interval
flags.description: --wait 的轮询间隔；默认 5s
flags.constraints: only with wait; >0

flags.constraints: t2i|i2i (t2i=text-to-image, i2i=image-to-image); explicitly required when any generation parameter is supplied; metadata-only saves and clear-generation do not require mode

flags.description: 完整图片生成提示词；引用写成 {{node:node_xxx}}、{{res:resourceId}}、{{uri:value}} 或 {{vid:value}}，写字面 {{ 用 \{{ 转义；画布已有来源节点时优先使用 Node ID，保留上游连线；Resource ID 用于资产库等无来源节点的素材或用户明确要求冻结，不自动从节点产物提取
flags.constraints: may be empty at save time if the model spec permits; Core validates effective text before run; create --run needs explicit title when prompt is empty

flags.name: model
flags.description: 服务端登记的图片模型标识

flags.name: ratio
flags.description: 图片宽高比，例如 1:1

flags.name: resolution
flags.description: 图片分辨率，例如 1K

flags.name: count
flags.description: 生成数量；上限以 model list 返回的 --count max 为准
flags.constraints: >0 and int32; dynamic maximum is the --count max from model list

flags.name: ref
flags.description: 完整类型化引用集合：node:value、res:value、uri:value 或 vid:value，可重复传入；画布已有来源节点时优先使用 Node ID，保留上游连线；Resource ID 用于资产库等无来源节点的素材或用户明确要求冻结，不自动从节点产物提取
flags.constraints: ordered type:value references; type is node|res|uri|vid; node value requires node_ prefix; res value requires canonical lowercase UUID

flags.name: run
flags.description: 保存后依次报价、批准并运行该节点
flags.constraints: when false, only save the draft; when true, save → estimate → approve → run

flags.name: submit-id
flags.description: 稳定提交 UUID；--run 或 --resource-id 时省略则生成，停顿后续跑或重试导入须复用它
flags.constraints: UUID; with run, or with resource-id as the imported resource batch identity; generated when omitted; non-empty when supplied

flags.name: credit-token
flags.description: 已批准的 creditConfirmationToken；--run 时使用
flags.constraints: only with run; creditConfirmationToken issued by node confirm; mutually exclusive with credit-ceiling

flags.name: credit-ceiling
flags.description: 批准的积分消费上限；--run 时报价超过它会在运行前停止
flags.constraints: >=0; only with run; mutually exclusive with credit-token; stops before run when the estimate exceeds it

flags.name: wait
flags.description: --run 后等待该节点生成进入终态
flags.constraints: only with run; wait for the submitted node to become terminal

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: --wait 的最长等待时间；默认 10m，0 表示只查询一次
flags.constraints: only with wait; 0 means query once

flags.name: interval
flags.description: --wait 的轮询间隔；默认 5s
flags.constraints: only with wait; >0

flags.description: 1..20 个唯一来源图片节点，可重复传入
flags.constraints: 1..20 unique canonical source Node IDs; each must resolve to one eligible successful image

flags.name: submit-id
flags.description: 逐节点提交 UUID，等长同序；省略时独立生成
flags.constraints: unique UUIDs; optional, otherwise same count and order as node-id; never empty

flags.name: mode
flags.description: normal=超清；pro=智能超清
flags.constraints: normal|pro

flags.name: resolution
flags.description: pro 必填：目标分辨率 2K、4K 或 8K；normal 不接受
flags.constraints: 2K|4K|8K; required for pro and rejected for normal; target-vs-source eligibility remains server-authoritative

flags.name: detail
flags.description: 仅 pro：细节强度 1..100，默认 50
flags.constraints: 1..100; pro only; omit for normal

flags.name: title
flags.description: 新产物节点标题；不修改来源节点
flags.constraints: non-empty when provided; new output node title, source is unchanged

flags.name: credit-token
flags.description: 本操作专用短期凭证，不接受 node confirm 凭证
flags.constraints: image-upscale scoped token only; mutually exclusive with credit-ceiling

flags.name: credit-ceiling
flags.description: 批准的整批积分上限，不能与 --credit-token 同用
flags.constraints: >=0; approval only when explicitly provided; entire batch ceiling

flags.name: wait
flags.description: 提交后只读等待生成终态；默认只返回受理结果
flags.constraints: wait for output resources, not source node state

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: --wait 最长等待时间；0 表示只查一次
flags.constraints: >=0; requires wait

flags.name: interval
flags.description: --wait 轮询间隔
flags.constraints: >0; requires wait

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: 只校验本地参数，不联网、报价、生成或写 journal
flags.constraints: local validation only; no runtime, network, credit estimate, approval, journal, or generation
